rawFindings.title: Incorrect exclusion of export declarations from single child allowed statements
rawFindings.explanation: The regex SINGLE_CHILD_ALLOWED no longer includes ExportDefaultDeclaration and ExportNamedDeclaration. This causes the rule not to skip counting directly nested single export declarations as one statement, which is a regression from previous behavior.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the regex to include export declarations as in the previous version: /^(?:(?:DoWhile|For|ForIn|ForOf|If|Labeled|While)Statement|Export(?:Default|Named)Declaration)$/
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: When checking lines with export default or export named declarations as a single statement, the rule wrongly counts nested statements as multiple statements, leading to incorrect reports.
